intro_md: 📖 **10 min.** A short lesson + a short text. You'll learn to **see where an idea goes** – that's what makes long sentences easy.

parts.title: Road signs in a sentence
parts.md:
When you read, small linking words are **road signs**. They tell you *before* the end of the sentence where the idea is going.

| Sign | The idea… | Read it like this |
|---|---|---|
| **although / even though** | turns: a surprise is coming | *Although he was tired* → (surprise!) *he helped.* |
| **but / yet / however** | turns: the second part is different | *It's small, **yet** it's always full.* |
| **rather** | corrects: *not A → B* | *He didn't text. **Rather**, he called.* |
| **in other words** | repeats: the same idea, more simply | *…**In other words**, go home and rest.* |
| **so / that's why** | continues: a result | *It was late, **so** he took a taxi.* |
| **because / since** | continues: a reason | *He smiled **because** it seemed to work.* |

💡 **Trick:** when you see a sign, **predict** the next part in your head – then check. Your brain stops translating and starts *following*.

parts.title: Nam's first week – in 6 short paragraphs
parts.md:
Read once, **don't go back**. At every **bold** word, think: *continue, turn, or repeat?*

> Nam's first week in Manchester was not easy. **Although** everyone was friendly, he felt tired all the time. New people, new streets, new words – his head was always full.
>
> He didn't try to remember every name. **Rather**, he wrote them in a small notebook and looked at it before meetings. It helped more than he expected.
>
> The weather was another surprise. It rained almost every day, **yet** nobody seemed to care. People just put up their hoods and kept walking.
>
> On Wednesday he got lost on the way to the office. He missed the tram stop, **so** he had to walk for twenty minutes in the rain.
>
> **However**, there were good moments too. Jess at the café remembered his order, and Tom always said hello. **In other words**, he was starting to feel at home.
>
> On Friday evening, Nam made a cup of tea, sat by the window and smiled. It had been a hard week, **but** a good one.

| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| *put up their hoods* | covered their heads with the top part of a jacket |
| *kept walking* | continued walking |
| *remembered his order* | knew what he always buys |

questions.q: Paragraph 2: *"Rather, he wrote them in a notebook."* What did he NOT do?

check.why: **Rather** = not A → B. Not *remember every name* → *write them down*.
